title: 10 Secret Claude Code Commands Nobody Talks About 🤫#ClaudeAI #shorts
description:
10 secret Claude Code slash commands that most developers have never used — including a hidden terminal pet (/buddy), instant undo (/rewind), safe experimentation (/branch), and 7 more that will change how you code with AI.

Commands covered in this video:
/buddy — hatch a terminal pet that watches you code
/rewind — undo mistakes, even after clearing chat
/branch — clone your session to experiment safely
/checkup — audit and clean your entire setup
/goal — keep Claude locked on one outcome
/btw — handle side questions without derailing your task
/effort — control how hard Claude thinks
/focus — strip your terminal down to essentials
/simplify — clean up messy code instantly
/usage — track your token cost in real time

Claude Code has 90+ slash commands and most developers only know a handful. Save this video and try one today.
